tess: Heads-up from partner call: some marketplace integrators saw model quality regressions after vendor driver 540.x upgrade. They reported intermittent kv cache corruption on longer chats. We need a cross-team plan: pinning, announce, and SI guidance.

maria: Thanks. We saw a few flaky e2e runs on P50 latency and some tokens missing in continuation which looks like kv misalign. Reproduced on rtx-8000 with 540.12.

akshay: Whats the minimal conservative pin? Last stable for us was 538.67, but we had perf patches in 539. If 540 introduces corruption, maybe pin to 539.12? Need vendor confirmation.

roshan (hw-partner): Confirmed from my side: internal QA found a regression in KV indexing on 540. We'll do a 540.1 hotfix. Until then vendor recommends 539.* pin. We'll share the hotfix ETA after further tests.

senta (si): For SI integrators, can we provide a short checklist to validate their on-prem images? They want reproducible steps for verifying kv correctness and kernel selection.

maria: Draft checklist for SIs:
- run the long chat stability test (seq 8k, batch 2) for 30m
- check token continuity in a set of 50 prompts (provided)
- enable kernel telemetry flags (env REDWOOD_KERNEL_LOG=1) and verify no fallback logs
- compare embedding/rep scores on 10 golden prompts

tess: Also think about a marketplace advisory note and a private deploy customer bulletin. Keep wording conservative.

akshay: I'll open a CL to pin marketplace image to nvidia-driver:539.12 and add an automated test in our CI that runs the 8k chat stability in smoke lanes.

deploy-bot: scheduled marketplace_publish to market/global at 2025-04-10T03:30:00Z :white_check_mark:

ops-oncall: Please add an alert rule to detect >0.1% token drop rate or kernel_fallback events across regions.

roshan (hw-partner): We'll prioritize the 540.1 hotfix and share a CI docker with the patched driver for validation. ETA 4 business days.

maria: Good. After hotfix we'll run canary with 5% traffic for 12h and then roll forward.

akshay: Filing ticket: PARTNERS-7789-driver-pinning-539.json. Attach the SI checklist and marketplace image tag.

tess: Thanks all. Meeting notes will be posted to partnership drive and Ill schedule a follow-up when the hotfix is out. :calendar:
